name: 08859 · Parlin, NJ
findings: ZIP 08859 (Parlin) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08859 (Parlin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
